# Real-Time Ad Performance Dashboard  

A lightweight dashboard for monitoring ad campaign metrics in real time, built with React and D3.js. Designed for adtech teams to track impressions, click-through rates, and ROI across platforms with minimal latency.  

## Badges  
[![Production-Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/production-ready-44bbff?style=flat)](https://example.com)  
[![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/react-28a745?style=flat)](https://reactjs.org)  
[![D3.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/d3.js-3498db?style=flat)](https://d3js.org)  
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/typescript-0078d7?style=flat)](https://www.typescriptlang.org)  

## Tech Stack  
- **Frontend**: React (functional components), TypeScript, D3.js (custom charts)  
- **Data**: REST API (fetches from ad platform endpoints)  
- **Tools**: Webpack (bundling), Axios (HTTP requests), CSS-in-JS (scoped styling)  

## Architecture / Design  
The app is structured as a single-page application with modular React components. D3.js powers the dynamic visualizations, ensuring smooth updates as new data arrives. State management is handled via React’s context API for performance-critical metrics. Responsive design prioritizes mobile usability, with a focus on clarity for dashboards viewed on multiple device sizes.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone the repository  
2. Run `npm install` to fetch dependencies  
3. Start the dev server with `npm start`  
4. Navigate to `http://localhost:3000` in your browser  

## Usage / Examples  
- **Real-Time Metrics**: View live impressions and click-through rates  
- **Campaign Breakdown**: Drill down into individual ad groups with interactive bar charts  
- **ROI Analysis**: Compare cost-per-click across platforms using line graphs  
- **Export**: Download CSV exports of historical data
